prerequisites: Knowledge of symbols, graphics, specific to electrical schemes

learning_outcomes.text: Use fundamental concepts of computer science and information technology
Design electrical systems and their components

Effectively use information and communication sources and assisted professional training (Internet portals, specialized software applications, databases, online courses etc.) both in Romanian and in a foreign language.
Acquire fundamental knowledge of engineering graphics, the universal language of communication in the technical field.
Study the most modern electrical and electronic schemes, including the advantages and disadvantages of each type, using computer-aided graphics.
Perform the actual study of electrical and electronic schemes with the help of OrCAD and Electronics Workbench.
Know and observe technical legislation in specialty areas, especially in the electrical field, for conducting activities in good technical and economic conditions and ensuring safety.

syllabus_topics: The graphic elements in the realization of electrical and electronic projects with the help of the computer
Conventional signs used in electrical and schemes
Basic rules in the representation of computer and electrical schemes
Electrical schemes. Computer-aided graphic representation methods
Overview of the OrCAD software package
Creating the OrCAD Capture PC Board Wizard project
Launch of the Orcad Capture program and the project management application.
Presentation of the Electronics Workbench program
Electronics Workbench program menu, editing the electronic drawing
Graphic examples of functional schemes made with OrCAD Capture
Graphic examples of circuit schemes made with OrCAD Capture
Graphic examples of equivalent schemes made with OrCAD Capture
Schematics of external, internal or OrCAD Capture terminals
Graphic examples of electronic schemes made with Electronics Workbench
teaching_methods: Courses by teaching subjects and engaging students in dialogues
Laboratory work with written materials and concrete instructions
Practical applications using computer network and specialized software (Orcad Capture, Electronics Workbench)

assessment_methods.method: Verification (Course component - Partial tests based on tests / homeworks, Overall rating, Practical Applications, Theory / Writing test)
Test + practical application (Laboratory component - Creating an execution drawing in OrCAD Capture, Electronics Workbench)

assessment_rules: The discipline ends at the end of the second semester. The minimum promotion mark is 5, with both course and laboratory components also scoring a minimum of 5. For the course, there are partial tests based on tests/homeworks, an overall rating, practical applications, and a theory/writing test. For the laboratory, there is a test plus a practical application creating an execution drawing in OrCAD Capture/Electronics Workbench. Each student receives a grade for laboratory work during the semester and for the laboratory work, resulting in a laboratory average.
